other_conditions: The Mentor Institute (MI) must be approved by AICTE, or be a Central Funded Institution where AICTE approval is not mandatory
MI must have a valid accreditation status for at least 6 months from the date of proposal submission
Institutes offering management, hotel management or other non‑engineering programs must also have accreditation valid for at least 6 months
Institutes exclusively offering diploma courses must have a minimum of four diploma programmes with accreditation valid for at least 6 months

The Mentee Beneficiary Institute (MBI) must be AICTE‑approved and must have never been enrolled as an MI, never mapped as an MBI with any other MI, and must have had no programmes accredited in the past ten years
The MBI should be located within approximately 200 km of the MI
MI must submit a list of up to 10 potential MBIs when applying
All participation is voluntary and no financial transactions are approved under the MoU
benefits_summary: Provides a token grant of up to ₹3,00,000 per mentee institute (maximum ₹30,00,000 for ten mentees) and staff honorarium limited to 4% of the grant.
documents_required: Signed application form from the Head of the Institute
Signature and stamp of the Head of Institute on every page of the application
